precision.note: decimals kept per file family; null means the value is the results float written at full double precision; observations and calendar dates are database values copied as stored

geometry.simplification: 700 m in a local azimuthal equal-area projection per polygon, topology preserved, coordinates to 1e-5 degrees (scripts/build_global_data.py); world outlines 0.025 degrees

world_units_reused.proof: All copied country and world geometry files match the frozen manifest; simplification unchanged

index.definition: mean of the monthly relative Nino 3.4 over December of the previous year, January and February of the harvest year; null where a month is missing

local_conditional_effects.validation: Full-record leave-one-year-out; each held year absent from every location in its crop/season pool; every scored fold has ten training years
limitations: Effect-interval calibration is under review; ranges exclude unexplained harvest variability.
New local effects carry no tonnes and do not enter national or world totals.
ENSO monthly disaggregation and common ranks retain the documented assumptions.
